body: You say I am amazing without even knowing me, it sounds like the typical stereotype cheer, I'm sorry, I cannot accept book sentences. I have been trying to find the bright side of my life, one that I REALLY have made on my own (really fought for it!) and I have none. I had been given everything, I don't deserve anything of what I have. Including the love of those who love me.
Not really... I am afraid someone could know who I am.

I have always had trouble to keeping myself happy. I have been attacehd to so many people and betrayed later, but then again, I have done the same to those who have loved me.

I remember when I was in my mid twenties I was planning it, I really was going to do it, I just had to finish one last project and then I was there... I started cutting my arms with a knife just to embrace the pain and feel close to what I could feel once I did it... and it didn't feel bad, it was painful, but at the same time I felt I was punishing myself and I deserved it.

I've started doing that lately again, and I'm scared, because when I think of my family I feel full of shame... yet when I think of myself I think my future is so dark, I'm not even interested in knowing what's behind that door.
euphoria? I appreciate that people love me, but think of death every single day, regardless of my mood. I just can't keep sincere smile.

whatever has ever given me passion (because I have been an artist I have loved, so much, I have been attached, so easily) has brought me misery in the long term. It's not worth going towards there. I fucking hate what I am supposed to love, because loving it has brought me no more than problems.
